aboutPreview: Native iPhone app in development. It does not have every function of the published app yet.
accessConditionalHint: Each write carries the revision of the robot this app last saw; if someone else changed the robot in between, the server refuses it and the robot is read again. Standard checks reservations, the table and one-off commands; Strict checks everything but STOP; Off checks nothing. Jog and speed are not checked in Standard because they repeat many times a second. STOP is never checked.
accessConditionalLabel: Check that the robot has not changed
accessMineElsewhere: Reserved by you on another device
accessMineHere: Reserved by you on this device
accessTakeOverMessage: {owner} holds this robot. Taking control ends their reservation and reserves the robot for you.
biometricNeedsSetup: Face ID or Touch ID is not set up on this device.
cameraDisabledHint: Use the switch above to enable it on the server
controlEnableHold: Safe mode - disabled. Hold to enable the robot
controlListenOnlyBanner: Listen only: commands are disabled. STOP still works.
controlNoRobots: No robots reported by the server
deadManBlockedAlready: This robot is already being moved.
deadManBlockedBadLink: The link to the server is too slow or lost: the continuous jog is blocked.
deadManBlockedMoving: The robot is running a trajectory: press STOP first.
deadManBlockedNotSupported: This server does not support the continuous jog.
deadManBlockedOff: Continuous jog is switched off. Turn it on in Settings.
deadManBlockedOffline: The robot is offline: it cannot be moved.
deadManBlockedRole: Only operators and administrators can move a robot.
deadManBlockedSafeMode: The robot is in safe mode: enable it first.
deadManBlockedStop: A STOP is being sent or was not confirmed: the jog waits until it is.
deadManEndedBadLink: The jog was stopped: the link to the server became too slow.
deadManEndedLinkLost: The jog was stopped: the heartbeat to the server failed.
deadManEndedRefused: The jog was stopped: the server refused it.
deadManEndedTooLong: The jog was stopped: the button was held longer than allowed.
deadManHint: The axis moves only while you hold the button. Letting go, losing the link or pressing STOP stops it.
deadManStopNotConfirmed: The stop of the jog was not confirmed. The server stops the axis by itself within a fraction of a second; check the robot.
deadManSwitchHint: Shows buttons that move an axis while you hold them. The app sends a heartbeat all the while and the server stops the axis when it stops; it also stops by itself if the link fails. Off by default.
discoverySteps:
1. Check that the phone uses the workshop Wi-Fi.
2. Check that the server is on.
3. Type its address.
errAdminRequired: Only an administrator can enable a robot.
errBadAddress: The address or the port is not valid.
errClaimControllerRequired: The reservation names a controller and this request named none. {detail}
errClaimOtherController: The robot is reserved by your account on another device or window. Use that one, or release the reservation there. {detail}
errEnableNotAllowed: The server does not allow enabling a robot from an app (the option is off). An administrator can turn it on in Server Admin.
errHomeRejected: The server refused the {command} command and the robot did not move: the pose is not the home pose of its model, or a joint would leave its range.
errJogNotArmed: The jog is not armed for this robot: arm it first.
errJogOutOfReach: That move is outside the robot's reach: nothing was sent.
errJogOverLimit: Jog refused: the step is above the limit of {limit} set by the server for this model. Nothing was sent.
errNoAnswer: The server did not answer. Check the address, the port and the network.
errPermissionDenied: Permission denied: this account cannot do that
errRevisionChanged: The robot changed since this app last read it (another operator or device) - the {command} command was NOT applied. The robot was read again from the server: check it and repeat the command if it is still wanted.
errRobotDisabled: The robot is in safe mode (disabled): the {command} command was not applied. Only STOP works until an administrator enables it.
errRobotReserved: The robot is reserved by another account: {owner}
errSavedDataBlocked: Command not sent: the screen shows saved data, not the live state
errServerReadOnly: The server is in read-only mode: the {command} command was not sent. Only STOP and the safe-mode disable go through. An administrator can switch it off.
errSessionEnded: The session ended. Sign in again.
errStaleSequence: A newer motion command from this phone had already reached the robot, so the {command} command was NOT applied because it arrived out of order. Repeat it if you still want it.
errStopNotConfirmed: STOP not confirmed by the server: press it again or use the physical E-stop
errStopSessionEnded: STOP not confirmed and the session ended. Use the physical emergency stop.
errTlsFailed: No secure connection to the server. If its certificate is self-signed, trust it under Security; if it only speaks plain HTTP, allow plain HTTP there.
firstRunFindText: On the same Wi-Fi as the server
firstRunStopText: At the top of every screen, also over windows and menus. One tap, no confirmation. It does not replace the physical emergency stop.
helpText: At home or in the workshop, join the same Wi-Fi as the server and search the network. From outside, use your VPN and type the address of the server. A server with its own certificate needs its fingerprint in the security settings.
homeMovingHint: Keep the area around them clear
homeResetBlockedJog: A jog is still being sent: wait a moment.
homeResetBlockedMoving: The robot is running a trajectory: press STOP first.
homeResetBlockedNoPose: This robot reports no position, so it has no zero to go to.
homeResetBlockedOff: HOME/RESET is switched off. Turn it on in the Access panel.
homeResetBlockedOffline: The robot is offline: it cannot be taken to zero.
homeResetBlockedRole: Only operators and administrators can take a robot to zero.
homeResetBlockedSafeMode: The robot is in safe mode: enable it first.
homeResetBlockedStop: A STOP is being sent or was not confirmed: HOME/RESET waits until it is.
homeResetNotSupported: This server does not support HOME/RESET.
homeResetStep1Message: The robot will go to its zero position. Check that nothing is in its way.
homeResetStep2Message: {robot} will move now. The STOP button stays available. Move to zero?
homeResetSwitchHint: Shows a button that takes the selected robot to its zero position. It moves the real robot, so it asks twice, only works for operators and administrators, and is off by default.
homeSafeModeHint: An administrator has to enable them
homeStopText: It is sent when you press it. If it is not confirmed, the app says so: use the physical emergency stop.
jogArmHint: The administrator requires the jog to be armed before it moves the robot. The arming ends by itself, with STOP, or when you release the robot.
linkBlockSwitchHint: When the answers from the server are too slow, or stop, the continuous jog is refused and a running one is stopped. On by default.
linkBlockSwitchLabel: Block the continuous jog on a bad link
linkIndicatorSwitchHint: Shows on the Control screen how fast the server answers. It sends one small request every two seconds.
loginCantConnect: Cannot connect? How to reach your server
loginCodeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
loginCodeNeeded: This account uses a second step. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
loginCodeWait: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
loginCodeWrong: That code is not right. Try the next one from the app, or use a recovery code.
loginScanNoneFound: No servers found on this network.
loginScanSkipMobileVpn: Do not scan mobile-data or VPN networks
moreChangeServerText: The session of this one stays on the phone
noticeStopUnconfirmed: STOP not confirmed by the server
noticesCalmHint: What this phone sees while the app is open, and the messages of the server, appear here.
pairingCameraUnavailable: The camera is not available. Paste the link instead.
pairingDialogPinReplace: Accepting sets the connection to require TLS and pins this certificate, replacing the fingerprint kept before.
pairingProblemFingerprint: The certificate fingerprint of the link is not valid.
pairingProblemGeneric: The pairing link is not valid.
pairingProblemHost: The pairing link has no valid server address.
pairingProblemName: The name in the pairing link is not valid.
pairingProblemNoFingerprint: The pairing link has no certificate fingerprint, so it cannot be used. Generate a new link on the admin page of the server.
pairingProblemNotLink: That is not a pairing link.
pairingProblemPort: The pairing link has no valid port.
pairingSwitchHint: The admin page of the server shows a QR code with its address and certificate fingerprint. Scan it with the phone camera, or paste the link here. The app shows what it read and asks before it keeps anything. Off by default.
pairingSwitchLabel: Allow pairing by QR code or link
playConfirmMessage:
{robot} will run the trajectory it has: {points} recorded points at {speed}% speed.
{reservation}
playConfirmOther: Reserved by {owner}: the server refuses the command if it is not yours.
pushDenied: Notifications are not allowed for this app. Allow them in the iOS Settings.
pushFailed: This phone could not be registered for notifications.
pushListenOnly: Listen only is on: this phone is not registered.
pushRegistered: This phone is registered: the server will notify it.
pushServerOff: This server has push notifications switched off.
pushSubtitle: Tells this phone when a job finishes or a global stop is issued. The server must have push notifications switched on.
pushUnavailable: This build has no Firebase configuration: push notifications are off.
recordBoardCounters: Send errors {tx}, receive errors {rx}, stalls {stalls}, running {uptime} s
recordBoardsNoAnswer: The controller of the server did not answer: nothing is known about the boards.
recordBoardsOff: This server does not have the board health on. An administrator turns it on in Server Admin.
recordBoardsUnavailable: The server could not read the boards.
recordFaultsOff: This server does not have its fault record on.
recordForbidden: Your account may not read this.
recordNotConnected: Connect to a server to read its record.
recordUnavailable: The server did not give this information.
robotsNone: No robot read from the server yet.
securityAllowPlain: Allow plain HTTP when HTTPS is not available
securityAllowPlainSubtitle: Only for servers on your local network.
securityAllowRemote: Also allow plain HTTP outside the local network
securityAllowRemoteSubtitle: The session token would travel readable across the Internet. Leave it off unless a trusted tunnel protects the link.
securityFetchFailed: No TLS connection could be made to {server}.
securityFingerprintInvalid: The fingerprint must be 64 hexadecimal digits.
securityIntro: The app connects over HTTPS. Plain HTTP is used only if you allow it below.
securityNeedsHost: Enter the host and port of the server first.
settingsBlockCachedCommandsSubtitle: Do not send commands while the screen shows the saved copy instead of the live state (STOP is never blocked)
settingsConfirmPlaySubtitle: Shows the robot, its recorded points, the speed and who has it reserved before a trajectory starts.
settingsListenOnlyServerSubtitle: Sends no command to the server in use except STOP and the safe-mode disable. Other servers are not affected.
settingsListenOnlySubtitle: Shows the robots and their data but sends no command: the controls are disabled. STOP always works.
settingsRequireBiometricSubtitle: Ask again on launch before reconnecting to a saved session
stopAllNotSaved: The stop is applied, but the server could not save it.
stopAllRobotByRobot: Stopped robot by robot (the global stop was not available).
stopPhysical: This app does not replace the physical emergency stop.
workBlockedNoTable: This Work uses an XY table and the robot has none.
workBlockedOffline: The robot is offline: a Work cannot be loaded.
workBlockedPlaying: The robot is running a trajectory: press STOP before loading another Work.
workBlockedRole: Only operators and administrators can load a Work.
workBlockedSafeMode: The robot is in safe mode: enable it first.
workBlockedStop: A STOP is being sent or was not confirmed: loading a Work waits until it is.
workEmpty: This robot has no saved Works on the server.
workInvalidFile: {file} is not a valid Work file: nothing was loaded.
workLoadFailed: The Work could not be read from the server.
workNotSupported: This server does not support loading a Work.
